batch: 7 (chs 49-55, Zion comforted and the suffering servant)

units.characteristics: the servant's felt-futility held with trust; the light to the nations
units.gist: SERVANT SONG 2 - 'the LORD called me from the womb... made my mouth like a sharp sword'; the honest cry 'I have LABORED IN VAIN; I have spent my strength for NOTHING and vanity - YET surely my right is with the LORD, my recompense with my God'; 'I will make you a LIGHT FOR THE NATIONS' - discouraged labour held together with trust in God's reckoning

units.characteristics: the sense of being forgotten answered by God's un-forgetting love
units.gist: THE GEM - 'Zion said, The LORD has FORSAKEN me; my Lord has FORGOTTEN me'; 'CAN A WOMAN FORGET HER NURSING CHILD, that she should have no compassion? Even these may forget, YET I WILL NOT FORGET YOU. Behold, I have ENGRAVED YOU ON THE PALMS OF MY HANDS'; 'those who wait for me shall not be put to shame' - the ache of being forgotten answered by love that cannot forget

units.characteristics: the taught ear that sustains the weary; the set face; trust in the dark
units.gist: SERVANT SONG 3 - 'the Lord GOD has given me the TONGUE of those who are TAUGHT, that I may know how to SUSTAIN WITH A WORD him who is weary; morning by morning he awakens my ear'; 'I gave my BACK to those who strike... I SET MY FACE LIKE A FLINT, and I know I shall not be put to shame'; 'let him who walks in DARKNESS and has no light TRUST in the name of the LORD'

units.characteristics: the fear of dying man vs forgetting the eternal Maker; the cup of wrath removed
units.gist: GEM - 'FEAR NOT the reproach of man, nor be dismayed at their revilings'; 'I, I am he who COMFORTS you; WHO ARE YOU that you are AFRAID OF MAN WHO DIES... and have FORGOTTEN THE LORD YOUR MAKER?'; the cup of staggering/wrath taken from Jerusalem's hand - fear of frail man exposed against the forgotten eternal God

units.characteristics: awake and arise; the beautiful feet that publish peace; God goes before and behind
units.gist: GEM - 'AWAKE, awake, put on your strength, O Zion... shake yourself from the dust and arise'; 'how BEAUTIFUL upon the mountains are the FEET of him who brings GOOD NEWS, who publishes PEACE... who says to Zion, YOUR GOD REIGNS'; 'the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your REAR GUARD'

units.characteristics: the man of sorrows who bears our griefs; silent under affliction; anguish that satisfies
units.gist: THE CROWN - SERVANT SONG 4 - 'he was DESPISED and rejected, a MAN OF SORROWS, acquainted with grief... surely he has BORNE OUR GRIEFS and carried our sorrows... he was PIERCED for our transgressions... with his WOUNDS WE ARE HEALED; all we like sheep have gone astray... the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all'; 'he OPENED NOT HIS MOUTH, like a lamb led to slaughter'; 'out of the ANGUISH OF HIS SOUL he shall SEE and BE SATISFIED... he poured out his soul to death... and makes intercession for the transgressors'

units.characteristics: the deserted wife restored; everlasting love; the covenant of peace unremovable
units.gist: GEM - 'SING, O barren one'; 'FEAR NOT, you will not be ashamed... your MAKER IS YOUR HUSBAND'; 'for a BRIEF MOMENT I deserted you, but with GREAT COMPASSION I will gather you... with EVERLASTING LOVE I will have compassion'; 'the mountains may depart... but my STEADFAST LOVE shall not depart, and my COVENANT OF PEACE shall not be removed'; 'all your children shall be TAUGHT BY THE LORD, and great shall be their PEACE'

units.characteristics: the free feast for the thirsty; the labour that does not satisfy; seek and return; higher thoughts
units.gist: THE GEM - 'COME, everyone who THIRSTS, come to the waters; he who has no money, come, buy and eat WITHOUT PRICE'; 'why do you spend your money for that which is NOT BREAD, and your labour for that which DOES NOT SATISFY?'; 'SEEK THE LORD while he may be found... let the wicked forsake his way... RETURN to the LORD, for he will ABUNDANTLY PARDON'; 'my THOUGHTS are not your thoughts... as the heavens are higher'; 'my word shall not return empty'; 'you shall go out in JOY'
